verses.text: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.emlaei: والذاريات ذروا
verses.translation: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
verses.transliteration: Waalththariyati tharwan

verses.text: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.emlaei: فالحاملات وقرا
verses.translation: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
verses.transliteration: Faalhamilati wiqran

verses.text: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.emlaei: فالجاريات يسرا
verses.translation: And those [ships] sailing with ease
verses.transliteration: Faaljariyati yusran

verses.text: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.emlaei: فالمقسمات أمرا
verses.translation: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter
verses.transliteration: Faalmuqassimati amran

verses.text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.emlaei: إنما توعدون لصادق
verses.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true
verses.transliteration: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun

verses.text: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.emlaei: وإن الدين لواقع
verses.translation: And indeed, the recompense is to occur
verses.transliteration: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.emlaei: والسماء ذات الحبك
verses.translation: By the heaven containing pathways
verses.transliteration: Waalssamai thati alhubuki

verses.text: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.emlaei: إنكم لفي قول مختلف
verses.translation: Indeed, you are in differing speech
verses.transliteration: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin

verses.text: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.emlaei: يؤفك عنه من أفك
verses.translation: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded
verses.transliteration: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika

verses.text: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.emlaei: قتل الخراصون
verses.translation: Destroyed are the falsifiers
verses.transliteration: Qutila alkharrasoona

verses.text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.emlaei: الذين هم في غمرة ساهون
verses.translation: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless
verses.transliteration: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona

verses.text: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.emlaei: يسألون أيان يوم الدين
verses.translation: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense
verses.transliteration: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni

verses.text: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.emlaei: يوم هم على النار يفتنون
verses.translation: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
verses.transliteration: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona

verses.text: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.emlaei: ذوقوا فتنتكم هذا الذي كنتم به تستعجلون
verses.translation: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient
verses.transliteration: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.emlaei: إن المتقين في جنات وعيون
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs
verses.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.text: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.emlaei: آخذين ما آتاهم ربهم إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين
verses.translation: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good
verses.transliteration: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena

verses.text: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.emlaei: كانوا قليلا من الليل ما يهجعون
verses.translation: They used to sleep but little of the night
verses.transliteration: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona

verses.text: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.emlaei: وبالأسحار هم يستغفرون
verses.translation: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness
verses.transliteration: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona

verses.text: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.emlaei: وفي أموالهم حق للسائل والمحروم
verses.translation: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived
verses.transliteration: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi

verses.text: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.emlaei: وفي الأرض آيات للموقنين
verses.translation: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
verses.transliteration: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena

verses.text: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.emlaei: وفي أنفسكم أفلا تبصرون
verses.translation: And in yourselves. Then will you not see
verses.transliteration: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona

verses.text: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.emlaei: وفي السماء رزقكم وما توعدون
verses.translation: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised
verses.transliteration: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona

verses.text: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.emlaei: فورب السماء والأرض إنه لحق مثل ما أنكم تنطقون
verses.translation: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking
verses.transliteration: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona

verses.text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.emlaei: هل أتاك حديث ضيف إبراهيم المكرمين
verses.translation: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham
verses.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena

verses.text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.emlaei: إذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلاما قال سلام قوم منكرون
verses.translation: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown
verses.transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona

verses.text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.emlaei: فراغ إلى أهله فجاء بعجل سمين
verses.translation: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
verses.transliteration: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin

verses.text: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.emlaei: فقربه إليهم قال ألا تأكلون
verses.translation: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat
verses.transliteration: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona

verses.text: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.emlaei: فأوجس منهم خيفة قالوا لا تخف وبشروه بغلام عليم
verses.translation: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy
verses.transliteration: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin

verses.text: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.emlaei: فأقبلت امرأته في صرة فصكت وجهها وقالت عجوز عقيم
verses.translation: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman
verses.transliteration: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun

verses.text: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.emlaei: قالوا كذلك قال ربك إنه هو الحكيم العليم
verses.translation: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing
verses.transliteration: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

verses.text: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.emlaei: قال فما خطبكم أيها المرسلون
verses.translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers
verses.transliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

verses.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.emlaei: قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين
verses.translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
verses.transliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

verses.text: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.emlaei: لنرسل عليهم حجارة من طين
verses.translation: To send down upon them stones of clay
verses.transliteration: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin

verses.text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.emlaei: مسومة عند ربك للمسرفين
verses.translation: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors
verses.transliteration: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena

verses.text: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.emlaei: فأخرجنا من كان فيها من المؤمنين
verses.translation: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers
verses.transliteration: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena

verses.text: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.emlaei: فما وجدنا فيها غير بيت من المسلمين
verses.translation: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims
verses.transliteration: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena

verses.text: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.emlaei: وتركنا فيها آية للذين يخافون العذاب الأليم
verses.translation: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment
verses.transliteration: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema

verses.text: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.emlaei: وفي موسى إذ أرسلناه إلى فرعون بسلطان مبين
verses.translation: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority
verses.transliteration: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin

verses.text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.emlaei: فتولى بركنه وقال ساحر أو مجنون
verses.translation: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun

verses.text: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.emlaei: فأخذناه وجنوده فنبذناهم في اليم وهو مليم
verses.translation: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy
verses.transliteration: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun

verses.text: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.emlaei: وفي عاد إذ أرسلنا عليهم الريح العقيم
verses.translation: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind
verses.transliteration: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema

verses.text: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.emlaei: ما تذر من شيء أتت عليه إلا جعلته كالرميم
verses.translation: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins
verses.transliteration: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi

verses.text: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.emlaei: وفي ثمود إذ قيل لهم تمتعوا حتى حين
verses.translation: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time
verses.transliteration: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin

verses.text: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.emlaei: فعتوا عن أمر ربهم فأخذتهم الصاعقة وهم ينظرون
verses.translation: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on
verses.transliteration: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona

verses.text: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.emlaei: فما استطاعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين
verses.translation: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves
verses.transliteration: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena

verses.text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.emlaei: وقوم نوح من قبل إنهم كانوا قوما فاسقين
verses.translation: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient
verses.transliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

verses.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.emlaei: والسماء بنيناها بأيد وإنا لموسعون
verses.translation: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander
verses.transliteration: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona

verses.text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.emlaei: والأرض فرشناها فنعم الماهدون
verses.translation: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer
verses.transliteration: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona

verses.text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.emlaei: ومن كل شيء خلقنا زوجين لعلكم تذكرون
verses.translation: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember
verses.transliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona

verses.text: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.emlaei: ففروا إلى الله إني لكم منه نذير مبين
verses.translation: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner
verses.transliteration: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

verses.text: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.emlaei: ولا تجعلوا مع الله إلها آخر إني لكم منه نذير مبين
verses.translation: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner
verses.transliteration: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

verses.text: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.emlaei: كذلك ما أتى الذين من قبلهم من رسول إلا قالوا ساحر أو مجنون
verses.translation: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman
verses.transliteration: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun

verses.text: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.emlaei: أتواصوا به بل هم قوم طاغون
verses.translation: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people
verses.transliteration: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona

verses.text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.emlaei: فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم
verses.translation: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed
verses.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin

verses.text: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.emlaei: وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين
verses.translation: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers
verses.transliteration: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena

verses.text: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.emlaei: وما خلقت الجن والإنس إلا ليعبدون
verses.translation: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me
verses.transliteration: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni

verses.text: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.emlaei: ما أريد منهم من رزق وما أريد أن يطعمون
verses.translation: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me
verses.transliteration: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni

verses.text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.emlaei: إن الله هو الرزاق ذو القوة المتين
verses.translation: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength
verses.transliteration: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu

verses.text: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.emlaei: فإن للذين ظلموا ذنوبا مثل ذنوب أصحابهم فلا يستعجلون
verses.translation: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me
verses.transliteration: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona

verses.text: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.emlaei: فويل للذين كفروا من يومهم الذي يوعدون
verses.translation: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised
verses.transliteration: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona
